cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ChimeraQuantumC LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
add_library(chimera_quantum_c STATIC src/chm_quantum.c)
target_include_directories(chimera_quantum_c PUBLIC include)
add_executable(chimera_quantum_c_test tests/test_quantum_api.c)
target_link_libraries(chimera_quantum_c_test PRIVATE chimera_quantum_c)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME chimera_quantum_c COMMAND chimera_quantum_c_test)
